invariant: For a parent supported by the reference validator, every unselected child must still be supported by a freshly built reference index. Selection index uses a warm shared AST cache.
limits: Finite authored cases, not general formal proof
Shared parser/validator semantics; no claim of independent ground truth
Repeated effective states are retained, not independent samples
No runtime execution of fixture code
negative_control: Suppress changed symbols for the signature mutation; checker must detect an unselected contradicted signature claim.
provenance_authority: authored synthetic support assumption; no real provenance modified
scope: Index/selection versus fresh structural validator; not an independent truth oracle or real closure authority
snapshot_scope: Constructed Snapshot/Blob objects with Git blob SHA-1 values; not a Git end-to-end run. Actual Git mode transitions are covered by the preceding regression.
size_limit_scope: The size_limit_same_blob mutation additionally checks cache/fallback behavior when an external read limit changes; it is outside the fixed-configuration carry argument.
